text: The gold medal in the event held at Richmond Olympic Oval on 14 February 2010 is not confirmed, as there was no event held at that venue on that date. The evidence indicates that the Men's 10,000 metres speed skating event took place at Richmond Olympic Oval on 23 February 2010, where Lee Seung-hoon won the gold medal [Q595972::0]. Therefore, the specific event and winner for 14 February 2010 at that venue cannot be determined from the provided evidence.
